meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用CDP协议控制Chrome浏览器，自动化执行页面操作与令牌提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要脚本化操作Chrome浏览器并复用已有登录态
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browsing and extract auth tokens
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to script Chrome interactions while reusing existing login sessions

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用已有登录状态，自动打开网页、读取页面内容、提取认证令牌、点击元素等。
howto.when: 当你需要控制 Chrome 浏览器进行自动化操作，或提到“浏览器操作”“CDP”“agent-browser”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 CDP 打开 https://example.com 并等待加载完成
say.note: Claude 将启动或复用 Chrome，导航到该页面。

say.text: 提取当前页面的认证 token
点击页面上 class 为 'login-btn' 的按钮
say.note: Claude 使用 snapshot 定位并点击元素。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol), reusing existing login sessions to automatically open URLs, read page content, extract auth tokens, click elements, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to automate Chrome browser operations or mention keywords like 'browser operation', 'CDP', 'agent-browser', etc.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com via CDP and wait for load
say_en.note: Claude will launch or reuse Chrome and navigate to the page.

say_en.text: Extract the auth token from the current page
say_en.note: Claude runs JavaScript to get token from localStorage or cookie.

say_en.text: Click the button with class 'login-btn' on the page
say_en.note: Claude uses snapshot to locate and click the element.
